binance_usdm.default_schedule_in_scope: 8H unless venue rule changes the contract schedule; realized timestamps remain authoritative for actual settlements

schedule_rule_change.rule: If the previous USD-M perpetual funding settlement reaches the funding cap or floor, Binance may adjust settlement frequency from every 8h or 4h to every 1h; once adjusted under this rule it does not revert under the 2025 rule.

formula_change.rule: Funding formula changed to [Average Premium Index + clamp(interest rate - Premium Index, 0.05%, -0.05%)] / (8/N), where N is the funding interval in hours; interest rate is 0.01% except specified contracts outside the BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT scope exception list.

binance_usdm.audit_rule: Actual BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT settlement cadence in the frozen replication partition must be inferred from realized funding timestamps and slot occupancy, not assumed from the default schedule.

hyperliquid.formula_semantics: Published funding formula is expressed on an 8-hour basis and one eighth of the computed rate is paid each hour.
hyperliquid.payment_semantics: Funding is peer-to-peer and the hourly payment is position_size * oracle_price * funding_rate.
hyperliquid.audit_rule: Actual hourly settlements in the frozen replication partition must pass unique scheduled-slot occupancy; missing events are never interpolated.
